message.content: end_turn {"public_message": "Orange stays at three, four, and four. Ending my turn.", "private_thought": "Cash $23 after St. James sale and $50 Boardwalk rent. Do not sell more: 3/4/4 rents $550/$750/$800 are the win condition, and only p4 ($216) can buy the 1 house in the bank ($150 yellow). p2 ($95) and p3 ($49) cannot build. From Boardwalk, mortgaged light blue/RR/utility pay nothing; real risks are Income Tax $200 (roll 4), Chance (roll 7), St. Charles 1h $50 (roll 11). Sell the minimum only in a debt phase. Do not trade orange, GOOJF, or Short Line. Jail card is shelter. No unmortgage available."}
message.reasoning:
I need to make a decision for the current Monopoly turn.

I have $23 cash and am on BOARDWALK after paying $50 rent. I can sell houses on TENNESSEE_AVENUE or NEW_YORK_AVENUE, but no further sales are needed. I will end the turn.

I am reconsidering. With only $23 cash, I need liquidity before rolling from Boardwalk next turn. I am checking which properties I could land on.

Rolling from Boardwalk lands on light blue and utility spaces. All of p3's light blues are mortgaged, so those properties collect no rent.

Rolling a 4 from Boardwalk lands on Income Tax for $200. That is impossible with only $23. Rolling a 10 lands on Jail. Rolling an 11 lands on St Charles, where p3 has one house and rent is $50.

Rolls 7 and 12 are also risky. I cannot sell preemptively to cover the $200 tax; that would release too many houses.

I am now considering trading my Get Out of Jail Free card for cash. p4 has $216 and could pay for it. This would give me the liquidity needed to survive the Income Tax risk next turn.

Trading the Get Out of Jail Free card for cash seems unlikely to work. p4 owns mortgaged Park Place, so they probably would not pay much for the card. Selling orange properties would break my monopoly. I should not trade with p2 either, since they own Boardwalk and I just paid them rent.

Selling one house would release only one house from the bank. p4 could buy it for $150, but p2 cannot afford a house and p3 cannot afford a pink house. The remaining house would sit idle in the bank, so selling preemptively does not help opponents build.
